evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that this model, a Llama-3-70B variant finetuned on the Infinity-Instruct-3M and Infinity-Instruct-0625 datasets, shows favorable AlpacaEval 2.0 results compared with GPT4-0613.

identity.name: Infinity Instruct
identity.summary: An open-source supervised instruction-tuning model that does not use reinforcement learning from human feedback.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only AlpacaEval 2.0 results and gives no details on model design, development, or evaluation process beyond the fine-tuning datasets.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card names Infinity-Instruct-3M and Infinity-Instruct-0625 but does not document how these datasets were collected, curated, or used.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight model is fine-tuned on Infinity-Instruct datasets whose origin, ownership, and usage terms are not described in the card.

possible_risks.description: Historical and societal biases might be present in data that are used to train and fine-tune models. Biases can also be inherited from seed data or exacerbated by synthetic data generation methods.
possible_risks.justification: Supervised instruction tuning on large web-derived instruction datasets without RLHF or reported bias analysis can inherit historical and societal biases from the training data.

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports only AlpacaEval 2.0 results and gives no evidence that the Infinity-Instruct training data is representative of real-world instruction-following use.

specifications.model_size: 131.4 GiB of safetensors weights (141,107,497,872 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is an open-source supervised instruction tuning model without RLHF. It was produced by fine-tuning the Infinity-Instruct-3M-Llama3-70B foundational instruct model on Infinity-Instruct-0625.
training_context.training_data: The model is a supervised instruction-tuned version of Llama3-70B, first trained on the foundational Infinity-Instruct-3M dataset and then further fine-tuned on Infinity-Instruct-0625 to produce this chat model.
